title: Administrative buffer action
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Boolean Turing machine, let $x,y$ be Boolean words, let $c_0$ be a configuration of $M$ on input $x$, let $q,q'$ be optional states of the clean wrapper of $M$, let $p$ be an input-head position, and let $h$ be an integer. For any input-head displacement $m$ and capture-head displacement $d$, applying the buffer action with successor state $q'$ to the administrative configuration formed from $c_0,y,q,p,h$ gives the corresponding configuration with state $q'$, input-head position moved from $p$ by $m$ (with boundary clamping), and capture-head position $h+d$, with its other fields unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Boolean Turing machine
$c_0$ is a configuration of $M$ on input $x$
$q,q'$ are optional states of the clean wrapper of $M$
replaced:
For any displacements $m, d$ and control states $q, q'$, applying the two-head
administrative action with displacements $m, d$ and next state $q'$ to an
administrative configuration of the clean wrapper in state $q$ yields the
administrative configuration with the same tapes, retained word and empty output,
in state $q'$, with the native input head moved by $m$ and the capture head moved
by $d$.
